## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes (lint, typecheck, tests)

- [ ] Tried on web, and on Android or Expo Go if the change touches native behaviour
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated
- [ ] ADR added if this changes an architectural decision
